 2025:KER:90229 CON.CASE(C) No.2627 OF 2025  3  JUDGMENT 1.
The learned Special Government Pleader submitted that the judgment is already complied with and a copy of the same was furnished to the petitioner on 20/11/2025.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has certain grievance against the order.
3. In such case, it is for the petitioner to work out the remedies against the said order.
Reserving that liberty, this Contempt Case is closed.
